# Test fixtures

| File | Source | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `hello.pdf` | generated by `generate_hello_pdf.rb` (hand-built, dependency-free) | basic open / extract_text / words / render round trips |
| `encrypted_stub.pdf` | generated by `generate_encrypted_stub_pdf.rb` (hand-built) | `PdfDioxide::PasswordError` path — recognised as encrypted but undecryptable, so `page_count` raises `EncryptedPdf` |
| `multipage.pdf` | generated by `generate_builder_fixtures.rb` (via `DocumentBuilder`) | page iteration (`each` / `[]`), page ops (`delete_page` / `select_pages` / `extract_pages*`), merge/split |
| `form_fields.pdf` | generated by `generate_builder_fixtures.rb` (via `DocumentBuilder`) | `get_form_fields` / `get_form_field_value` / `flatten_forms`, `get_annotations`, `extract_tables` |
| `form_xobject_text.pdf` | generated by `generate_form_xobject_pdf.rb` (hand-built) | Ext object-model primitives (`page_object` / `resolve` / `form_xobject?` / `stream_data` / `Ext.content_operators`) — Form XObjects with text, graphics-only, nested (Form→Form), plus an Image XObject; page 1 has no direct-text Form |
| `outline.pdf` | copied from upstream `pdf_oxide/tests/fixtures/outline.pdf` (MIT / Apache-2.0) | `get_outline`, `plan_split_by_bookmarks` / `split_by_bookmarks` |

Regenerate the generated ones with:

```bash
ruby test/fixtures/generate_hello_pdf.rb
ruby test/fixtures/generate_encrypted_stub_pdf.rb
ruby test/fixtures/generate_form_xobject_pdf.rb
bundle exec ruby test/fixtures/generate_builder_fixtures.rb   # needs a compiled extension
```
